title: AG60031: Plant Metabolites And Separation Technology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to primary and secondary plant metabolites; National and
international scenarios on secondary metabolites production technology. Basic
principles of separation techniques, strategies of downstream processing with
optical references to plant metabolites, different techniques adopted for
separation of biomolecules, Chromatographic separation process, scale-up
methods, large scale purification of biomolecules, electrophoresis,
chromatofocussing, supercritical fluid extraction, Liquid-liquid extraction,
UF, aquous two phase separation, IMAC, GFC, IEC, Pseudo-biospecific affinity
chromatography, HIC, covalent chromatography, capillary electrophoresis,
Rotaphore.
